measurement.tolerance_rule: max_regression_delta = 2 x the largest per-metric sample standard deviation of the run means, rounded up to 0.01 (minimum 0.01); metrics = mean of the run means
measurement.notes: Measured on the final integration code: fix/audit-spec-issue-2 at d7fc78e (all of spec #2 including ticket-19 and the review-fixes merge). Supersedes the earlier pre-#19 measurement (faece2c plus ticket-16; means 0.8286/0.8080/0.8648/0.8832, tolerance 0.05). Three sequential `lattice-rag eval --output` runs, Gold Set v2 (30 queries), ephemeral DB, macOS, local ONNX models, GUARDRAIL_SKIP_RERANK_SCORE unset. No pipeline or judge errors; Groq returned 429 on 0/2/3 queries per run and those answers came from the Gemini fallback, so that noise is inside the measurement. faithfulness sd 0.0292 is the widest: 2 x 0.0292 = 0.0584, rounded up to 0.06. Per-run passed queries 23/22/23. Noul contradiction vetoes (faithfulness 0.0): long_context eval_28 (run 1), eval_20 (run 2), eval_20 and eval_30 (run 3), i.e. 1/1/2 on long_context; run 3 also vetoed multihop eval_21.
